---
name: New Script Proposal
about: Propose a new tool to add to the menu
title: '[SCRIPT] '
labels: new-script
assignees: ''
---

**Tool name**
The name of the tool or package.

**Category**
Which menu folder: monitoring, network, llm, git, postsetup-kali, proxmox, education, or NEW.

**What it does**
One or two sentences describing the tool.

**Install method**
How is it installed? (apt, brew, snap, binary download, pip, npm, etc.)

**Works on**
- [ ] Linux (Debian/Kali/Ubuntu)
- [ ] macOS

**check_command**
The command to verify installation (e.g., `mytool --version`).

**Why include it?**
Why is this tool useful for the target audience?
